# pvecli vm edit

Interactively edit VM configuration.

```text
pvecli vm edit [VMID] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
